description: This file defines the abstract class `LoggerLayout`, which serves as a base for creating custom log layout formats in the log4php logging framework. It includes methods for instantiation, formatting log events, and retrieving header/footer content.

classes.name: LoggerLayout
classes.description: An abstract class that provides the foundation for creating custom log layout formats in log4php. It includes methods for instantiation, formatting messages, and returning header/footer content.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates an instance of a LoggerLayout subclass given its class name, attempting to include the class file if not already loaded.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Placeholder method meant to be overridden to activate or configure options after initialization.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log event into a string. By default, returns the rendered message from the event.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type handled by this layout, defaulting to 'text/plain'.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer content for the layout; null if none.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header content for the layout; null if none.
